name: Qingleng Feng
summary: The Qingleng Feng (清冷风, lit "clear-cold style") character is a common character trope seen in Wuxia and Xianxia drama, featuring aloof quiet mannerisms, pale delicate facial features, ethereal cool-toned costumes, and an overall detached, restrained and otherworldly aura.
